unsupported: Colorado Native Electric operates from Indian Hills and Littleton, Colorado, as a family-owned small business founded by Donlin and his wife, both lifelong Colorado residents.
Donlin brings over ten years of experience as a licensed electrician to the venture, which they run together as a local service operation.
Primary customers are homeowners in the Front Range area, including those preparing houses for sale who need inspection items resolved, as well as individuals building or remodeling custom homes.
